import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, handling commas and out-of-range values
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned_df = clean(df)
    avg_mass = cleaned_df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return avg_mass
